coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of eight ground-truth variable items match: R² is included as a consistent evaluation metric, the main protocol uses an 80%/20% training/testing split, and the design space contains 26 car-design parameters. Counting complete variable-item matches gives 38%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The fixed CSV path is omitted. Training sizes use a different progression rather than 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 95%/100%. The model roster includes RandomForest and LightGBM, but omits AutoGluon and GradientBoosting; XGBoost is mentioned without being included in the configured experiment matrix. Fastback-only versus combined-data experiments are replaced with pooled and leave-one-configuration-out tests. Performance reporting does not specify average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits, instead using five sampling repetitions and emphasizing RMSE.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It omits the expected improvement with larger training sets and the specific findings that AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario while LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
